# Native X6 revisit-history capacity: independent whole-paper review

Reviewer: EM-P11-4A56E9. Verdict: **PAPER_PASS, bounded to the paired frozen Phase A and already-frozen Phase B formulation below; zero mathematical must-fix findings.** Reuse disposition: **COMPOSE_APPLIED / RESULT_ONLY**, not a new general Tool family or a global novelty finding.

I did not contribute or repair the candidate's new construction. I declared this before reading it. All prior CONTROL, T6, P11, LC and review exposure remains NONBLIND. My existing Source activity has ten events, and its original startup helper returned exit0 with activity and persistence allowed, no synchronization debt and all formal authority flags false. Neither that bookkeeping nor this paper verdict is a Native vote, Tool registration, Foundation promotion or Task acceptance.

## 1. Exact object reviewed

The objects are CF1677's original `PHASE_A_FROZEN.md`, 11798 bytes, Source f6e05293e3c0ba07421e9e7faa4c13f9f183e237, SHA256 edb527f64f3baf2d8f0c14fb4499bb8da6069bd3ca1d7ac77badaeac6d811f29, and the preexisting `PHASE_B_SELF_AUDIT.md`, 9617 bytes, Source82dd1734e9afe36b91974dcfc4e3ff0b88e0d905, SHA256 fa8dcb3be6d80bb283a855f046c2cdf48e556e35775a0612f36c3a872ed708d0. Both paths are under `research_notes/free_CF1677_20261016/`. I personally fetched, fully read and checked their complete immutable bytes, Git blobs and URLs. Phase B is a separately frozen author audit, not independent validation or a revision supplied during this review. The original Phase A file was not changed.

The Git-data metadata has Phase A's single parent67bdb692c36e238ba41fc59153965bbc6a748d6f and Phase B's single parent f6e05293e3c0ba07421e9e7faa4c13f9f183e237. These are immutable branch inputs. They are not canonical main Tool/theorem entries, and commit metadata does not attest a clean discovery history. The author's ANCHOR_EXPOSED and RAW/conditional-model history remains.

The model is a finite signed-unit walk in the full native Cell torsor, with arbitrary revisits. Its state for the question consists of the current Cell and the past visited set. Every future signed-unit word of length at most H is permitted, even after earlier contacts. At each future step the observer reports membership in the old visited set or the already traversed future prefix. The same deterministic decoder must work for every declared history. Current Cell, clock and H are free side information; a history-dependent codebook or another history-bearing side channel is not free information. The memory conclusion concerns fixed-capacity binary retained state, not computational running time, physical information density or an assertion that a native dynamical law implements this observer.

## 2. The exact quotient and decreasing-horizon update are valid

Fix a current Cell x. If two histories have the same old visited membership on the graph-reachability ball B_H(x), every future position of every admitted word lies in that ball. At each step the old-history membership tests agree, while the future-prefix membership test is identical because the word is the same. This proves equality of the full output word, not just its terminal bit.

Conversely, a differing Cell c in this ball cannot be x, which both histories visited. A shortest signed-axis path to c has no repeated Cell and has length at most H. Its last occurrence of c is its first occurrence in the new prefix, so its final output bit is precisely the differing old-history membership. Earlier contacts do not invalidate this probe because contact is nonabsorbing. This checks the necessity quantifier over all words and the reason for the stated nonabsorbing boundary.

For the online update, x'=x+s is in B_r(x) when r>=1. Reporting membership in the stored set before adding x' gives the correct next bit. The inclusion B_(r-1)(x') subset B_r(x) follows from one signed-unit step. Every old visit that can still matter is therefore available when forming `(S union {x'}) intersect B_(r-1)(x')`. Previously processed future Cells are already part of the updated visited set. No path order, branch multiplicity or weight has been silently declared irrelevant for another observer.

The current Cell is always visited. A fixed mask on the other N_6(H)-1 relative Cells suffices, with the separately supplied x and remaining horizon determining its interpretation. At H=0 all futures are empty and the mask is empty. The displayed N_6(H) count is the standard L1 lattice-ball count, already present in the matched T0 source. It is not a new result of this candidate. The graph L1 budget is correctly distinguished from the P000 six-component quadratic readout.

## 3. The lower-bound histories are genuinely realizable

For H>=1 let q=floor((H-1)/12)+1 and K=q^6. For every z in {0,...,q-1}^6 the target c_z=e1+2z has L1 distance at most 1+12(q-1)<=H. Targets have odd first coordinate and even other coordinates. Attachments a_z=c_z+e2 have odd second coordinate, and dummies d_z=a_z+e3 have odd third coordinate as well. Thus neither type is a target.

The target-avoidance checks hold for every connector, not just for its endpoints. Along a two-step index edge in axis j!=2 the second coordinate stays odd. In the four-step axis2 detour, each interior Cell has an odd second or odd third coordinate. Its reverse has the same property. The finite index grid is connected, so a fixed rooted spanning tree with K-1 edges exists; replacing each edge by a path of at most four primitive steps and traversing it twice gives at most8(K-1) steps and visits every attachment. No new diagonal primitive action or wait operation is used.

The entrance 0->e2->e1+e2 and its reverse avoid all targets. At each designated attachment visit, the fixed dummy excursion ensures d_z is visited for both bit values. The selected two-step excursion then visits c_z exactly for bit1, and otherwise repeats the dummy excursion. These excursions visit no other attachment or target. The fixed skeleton, entrance/exit and all dummy Cells are independent of the chosen bit string. Consequently the target intersection of the actual visited set is exactly the selected subset, while every non-target visit is independent of that string.

All walks start and finish at the same chosen Cell0. Each choice uses the same number of primitive steps, with common length T=4+2(sum of chosen tree-edge lengths)+4K<=12K-4. In particular the clock is the actual walk length, not a fabricated label or a side channel encoding the bits. Its parity is consistent with a closed signed-coordinate walk. Arbitrary finite past length and revisits are premises of the model; the proof does not claim this result under a fixed past-length cap or self-avoidance.

For two bit strings, choose a target on which they differ. A shortest probe to that target has no repeated Cell and length at most H, so its final bit distinguishes the histories. Earlier probes may already distinguish them; they cannot suppress the final observation in this language. Hence there are at least2^K distinct future signatures at the same start, final Cell, T and H. This is a realizability construction, not the unjustified assignment of arbitrary subsets to inaccessible past states.

For q>=2 all six index coordinates genuinely vary; for q=1 the correct singleton construction still works. The six-dimensional asymptotic exponent does not depend on misdescribing the degenerate small-H grid.

## 4. Cardinality, bits, and edge cases

Distinct signatures must give distinct retained machine states for a common exact decoder. Thus at least2^K states are required. A fixed-capacity m-bit register has2^m states, so m>=K. Since q>=H/12 for integral H>=1, K>=H^6/12^6. Together with the fixed N_6(H)-1 mask this proves the stated worst-case Theta(H^6) history-bit order, with Cell, clock and horizon excluded as declared free side information. The theorem also rules out one fixed finite history-state set that works for every H and every finite history.

The original Phase A sentence counting arbitrary strings of length at most m as2^m would be imprecise without a memory convention. Phase B explicitly supplies the fixed-capacity/padded-register convention and separately gives the correct2^(m+1)-1 variable-length count. I approve this paired formulation, not that unqualified counting sentence as a separate theorem. The state-cardinality proof is independent of any encoding convention. No author change during review was needed or made.

The Phase B H=1 control is also correct: at common start/end0 and T=24, every nonempty subset of the twelve neighbours is realized by one two-step excursion per selected neighbour, padded by repeating one selected excursion. Every such history must visit some neighbour. The exact4095 signatures require twelve fixed-capacity bits. This is a paper check of this particular population, not an executed enumeration. It neither claims all masks are realizable at every horizon nor changes the original weaker K=1 lower witness.

The resources being bounded are retained history states at a given horizon. The manuscript does not prove a processing-time bound, a complete finite compiler for unbounded pasts, a fixed finite population of all native states, or a physical storage law.

## 5. Bounded dedup and the actual increment

I personally fetched and read the entire existing `brc_contact_horizon.py`5273 bytes and `predictive_quotient.py`11347 bytes at Source67bdb692c36e238ba41fc59153965bbc6a748d6f, with blobs971cc4404f5abc21e7f64f0734a5dcf009af1efa and f27d9ddf908f5b07051acfaf0c69f359d499b98b. No module was imported or run. I additionally checked the exact current registry T6 entry, the finite predictive-compiler inventory entry and the contact ledger's HBRC-RP-007/008 entries from that same immutable Source. This is an exact, bounded route, not a repository-wide search.

T0 already supplies signed-unit reachability, the L1-ball formula, decreasing-horizon near/FAR contact abstraction, separating suffixes and a no-uniform-finite-quotient statement for two tagged positions. It explicitly excludes past contact history. T6 already supplies the future-language equivalence/refinement mechanism. Its executable compiler requires a finite explicitly supplied state set closed under its actions; one cannot silently run it on the candidate's population of all finite histories. The older predictive-minimality/capacity guard is background, not a new theorem here.

The author's two complete local coverage JSON files were hashed and the exact relevant records read. Their local HEAD7317568... is not substituted for the later pinned main modules. The author also supplied six existing managed GitHub query observations, all topn8 and empty. I inspected those actual shared responses without replaying the searches or calling them my own API observations. An initial oversized coverage display in this review was truncated; the relevant entries and all six query records were then separately displayed completely. No claim of complete semantic reading of unrelated catalog hits relies on that display.

These empty lexical searches prove neither absence of prior results nor global novelty. The concrete existing T0/T6 matches govern classification. The possible source-specific increment within the checked coverage is exactly the common-Cell/common-clock realizable2^(q^6) history construction and its tight six-dimensional fixed-capacity consequence. The checked interfaces do not already state that construction. Ordinary continuation-language distinguishability, counting and the ball formula are reused mechanisms. **COMPOSE_APPLIED with a RESULT_ONLY application** is appropriate; a fresh general family, new axiom or confirmed repository-wide capability gap is not justified. A later exact prior theorem can still close this increment as reuse/duplicate.

## 6. Native typing and exclusions

Before this review I loaded the fixed P000, Heartbeat X6/time, joint-observer preservation, residual-fidelity and native Cell-torsor contracts, then verified their actual immutable Source bytes. The construction uses all six signed spatial axes. Its0 is a chosen Cell anchor; no final public address or distinguished ontic origin is introduced. Step order is separately typed time. No plane, additional memory axis, 90-degree native geometry, primitive two-force balance, signed branch cancellation or physical time calibration is asserted.

The visited-set quotient is safe exactly for the declared nonabsorbing stepwise revisit language. It does not preserve old ordered-path identity, multiplicity, amplitudes, unrelated observers or every future operation. Absorbing first-hit output, restricted future words, self-avoiding pasts, a hard past-length cap, non-coordinate jumps, approximate answers and a coarser final-only observer remain different scopes. The proof gives no unrestricted native propagation law or new world axiom.

## 7. Disposition and durable boundary

All core mathematical claims of the paired frozen formulation pass this ordinary bounded whole-paper review. There are **zero mathematical must-fix findings**. The original author files, their RAW/ANCHOR_EXPOSED history, the variable-length wording clarification and the existing Tool ownership remain unchanged. This is an independent new review, not a propagation of any LC or other prior PASS.

The review recommends retaining one source-specific conditional result/interface under the existing T0/T6 methods, with the state-cardinality theorem stated before its fixed-register bit consequence. Publication of the author branch or of this review is data custody; neither is canonical mathematical promotion. No Tool/Task/Native or another actor's activity is registered by this report.
